snippet.title: Bullet Time Agent Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell, coming soon to Steam, SteamVR, and Meta Quest!  
Wishlist on Steam now:   https://store.steampowered.com/app/4350110/Bullet_Time_Agent/
Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Thread laser gauntlets with superpowered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.
